A '''synthe-nutrient replicator''' was a medical tool. It could create vital nutrients that could be administered to patients to keep them alive. Synthe-nutrient replicators were included in [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries']] [[FastFlesh medpac/Legends|FastFlesh medpac]].<ref name="EGWT" />
